original_value: Even Slimmer DesignThe HV620S takes the proven performance and reliability of our existing 2.5” external hard drives and re-defines them. At only 11.5mm in profile, it’s super-slim for sleek elegance and superior portability, fitting easily in any briefcase or backpack. From meeting rooms to treks in nature, the HV620S never gets in the way and always adds a touch of style to your storage.Scratch-Prevention DesignA raised lip on the edge of the drive protects the surface from scratching when the drive is laid flat.Sleek and GlossyThe sleek lines and reflective, smooth surface of the HV620S highlights its thin and elegant overall appearance. It is ideal for those who wish to maintain an aura of professionalism, or show off their technical savvy.LED Indicator Shows Transfer StatusA bright blue LED lets you know when data is being read from or written to the HV620S. This helps prevent disconnection during read/write operations.

result.paraphrase: Even slimmer design: the HV620S builds on the proven performance and reliability of our existing 2.5” external hard drives, but redefines them. Measuring just 11.5 mm thick, it is ultra-slim for refined style and easy portability, slipping into a briefcase or backpack with ease. Whether in a meeting room or on a nature trek, the HV620S stays out of the way while adding a stylish touch to your storage. Scratch-prevention design: a raised edge lip protects the drive’s surface from scratches when laid flat. Sleek and glossy: its clean lines and reflective, smooth finish emphasize the HV620S’s thin, elegant look. It suits users who want to project professionalism or display technical know-how. LED indicator shows transfer status: a bright blue LED indicates when data is being read from or written to the HV620S, helping prevent disconnection during read/write operations.
